cues.title: 把水作为唯一比较条件
cues.caption: 干纸条保留颜色，湿纸条褪色。
cues.captionEn: Dry paper keeps colour; damp paper fades.
cues.zh: 两个集气瓶都盛有干燥氯气，有色纸条的差别在于是否湿润。观察一段时间，干纸条基本保留颜色，湿纸条逐渐褪色。这组对照说明，在教材条件下，不能只把褪色归因于干燥氯气与纸条直接接触，还必须把水的参与考虑进去。比较的是含水状态，纸条材料和观察条件应保持相近。
cues.en: Both jars contain dry chlorine, while the coloured papers differ in whether they are damp. The dry paper retains its colour and the damp paper fades. Under the textbook conditions, contact with dry chlorine alone is therefore not a sufficient explanation: water must be included. A useful comparison keeps the paper material and observation conditions otherwise similar.

cues.title: 鲜花带着自己的水
cues.titleEn: A fresh flower brings its own water
cues.caption: 气体虽干燥，鲜花组织仍含水。
cues.captionEn: Dry gas; water inside the flower.
cues.zh: 再把有色鲜花作为观察对象。它在干燥氯气中也会变色。这并没有推翻前面的干湿对照，因为干燥说的是气体，鲜花组织本身仍含有水。不要把整瓶气体的状态，误当成瓶中每个物体都干燥。鲜花的例子把纸条实验中的水条件，迁移到了真实的含水组织。
cues.en: A coloured fresh flower also changes in dry chlorine. This does not contradict the paper comparison: dry describes the gas, while the tissue still contains water. The condition of the surrounding gas does not make every object inside the jar dry. The flower transfers the same water-dependent explanation from paper to living tissue.

cues.title: 把观察连接到化学变化
cues.caption: 水参与形成次氯酸，使着色结构改变。
cues.captionEn: Water enables HOCl formation and colour change.
cues.zh: 在湿润表面，氯气溶于水，并与水发生可逆反应，形成盐酸和次氯酸。教材把漂白作用联系到次氯酸的强氧化性：色素原来的着色结构被改变，颜色便可能减弱或消失。图中断开的圆点只是结构变化的概念示意，不能当成某一种真实色素的完整反应式。干湿对照支持水参与，至于各个实际产物，还需要更具体的化学分析。
cues.en: At a wet surface, chlorine dissolves and reacts reversibly with water to form hydrochloric acid and hypochlorous acid. The textbook connects bleaching to the strong oxidizing action of HOCl, which changes colour-bearing structures. The separated dots are a conceptual representation, not a complete reaction formula for a particular pigment. The dry–damp comparison supports the involvement of water; identifying actual molecular products requires further chemical analysis.

question.zh: 同样的干燥氯气，为什么一条纸褪色、一条不变？
question.en: Why does only one paper fade in the same dry chlorine?

lead.zh: 把干湿纸条与鲜花并排考虑，区分气体状态和样品自身含水。
lead.en: Compare dry and damp papers with a flower, distinguishing the gas from the water inside a specimen.

principle.zh: 教材干湿对照支持水参与：氯气在水中部分反应形成次氯酸，氧化作用可改变着色结构。鲜花组织自身含水，所以气体干燥并不排除变色。
principle.en: The textbook comparison supports the involvement of water. Chlorine partly reacts in water to form HOCl, whose oxidizing action can alter colour-bearing structures. Fresh tissue contains water even when the gas is dry.

question.zh: 同一张湿纸条若没有接触氯气，本模型还会预测漂白吗？
question.en: Would the same damp paper bleach in this model if chlorine were absent?

explanation.zh: 不会。水是这组比较中的必要条件之一，并非单独的漂白剂；没有氯气供给，模型保留原着色结构。这里不概括其他氧化剂或任意有机物。
explanation.en: No. Water is one necessary condition in this comparison, not a bleaching reagent by itself. Without chlorine, the model retains the original colour-bearing structure. This does not describe other oxidants or every organic material.
